Partial derivative of tensor expressions

Source: R/tensor-tensor.R
PartialDerivative.Rd

Port of SymPy's PartialDerivative (sympy/tensor/toperators.py): the derivative of a tensor expression expr with respect to tensors or symbols. The indices of a tensor variable enter with opposite valence; repeated indices are contracted. Nested derivatives are flattened. pd_perform_derivative() evaluates the derivative with Kronecker deltas and metrics; pd_expand() applies the sum and product rules.

Usage

PartialDerivative(expr, ...)

pd_expand(e)

pd_perform_derivative(e)

Arguments

expr

A tensor expression or a scalar expression.

...

Variables: tensors or symbols.

e

A PartialDerivative or tensor expression.

Value

A PartialDerivative, tensor expression or sym.

Examples

L <- TensorIndexType("L")
i <- TensorIndex("i", L); j <- TensorIndex("j", L)
A <- TensorHead("A", list(L))
PartialDerivative(A(i), A(j))
#> PartialDerivative(A(i), A(j)) 
pd_perform_derivative(PartialDerivative(A(i), A(j)))
#> KD(i, -j)
